capabilities: Chat with vault notes in a sidebar
Run vault-native tools and Agent Skills
Connect MCP servers and web search
extras: Desktop only: macOS supported, Windows/Linux in preview, no iOS/Android. Stable builds ship via Community Plugins; optional BRAT beta builds may be unstable. Requires Obsidian File Recovery for edits (mutations blocked if snapshot fails). MCP is remote-only (Streamable HTTP); stdio not supported. No telemetry. Extensive external docs (recipes, developer handbook, SECURITY.md).
motivation: To give writers AI collaboration with fine-grained precision inside the vault, rather than black-box generation or a repurposed coding agent.
problem: Existing AI coding agents require a separate app or terminal and are built for software engineering rather than knowledge work inside the vault.

relations.evidence: The Pi agent runtime that powers Pivi
Claudian — Code lineage this version is adapted from
Install kepano/obsidian-skills or other Agent Skills into .pivi/skills/
With the Style Settings plugin installed, customize chat typography
Add the current editor selection or a custom Pivi command to an installed Note Toolbar
Optional integration with the official Obsidian CLI
install through BRAT (Beta Reviewer's Auto-update Tool)

requires.name: Local LLM server (Ollama, LM Studio, or llama.cpp)

summary: An AI agent that runs inside Obsidian for chatting with notes, editing inline, and delegating tasks through vault-native tools and subagents.
